**Not found with these tools.** I couldn't confirm the name of anyone nominated to BBSI's Board in 2024.

**What I found:**
- **The likely source exists, but I couldn't read it.** BBSI filed its 2024 proxy (preliminary on 10 Apr 2024, final on 22 Apr 2024), and both matched searches about director nominations. The search tool only returns links to filings, not their text, so I couldn't pull the nominees' names out of them.
- **No phrase match.** An exact search for "Nominated to Serve on BBSI" in filings from January 2024 to 16 May 2025 found nothing. The other 8-K filed on 10 April 2024 is not a director announcement: it didn't match a search for "director."
- **No new director filings in 2024.** New directors file a Form 3, and BBSI has none dated in 2024. The most recent one is from Mark Steven Finn, filed 8 April 2025 (period of report 7 April 2025), marked as a director and holding 4,850 common shares. Before that, the latest director Form 3 was Joseph Stephen Clabby's in September 2022. This suggests no new director actually joined the Board during 2024. The 2024 proxy may simply have re-nominated sitting directors, but I couldn't check that. The Form 3 data can't show nominees who hadn't yet joined.
- **Possibly a 2025 event.** Finn's April 2025 filing hints that the announcement you're thinking of may have been about him in early 2025, not 2024. I couldn't confirm this from any filing text.

**What's missing:** the text of the 2024 proxy's director-election section, or a press release announcing the nomination. Reading the DEF 14A at the link below would settle it.

**Sources**
- DEF 14A, filed 2024-04-22, accession 0000950170-24-046428 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/902791/000095017024046428/bbsi-20240422.htm)
- PRE 14A, filed 2024-04-10, accession 0000950170-24-043360
- 8-K, filed 2024-04-10, accession 0000950170-24-043355 (Item 8.01, not a director announcement)
- Form 3 (Mark Steven Finn), filed 2025-04-08, accession 0001562180-25-003068
- Form 3 (Joseph Stephen Clabby), filed 2022-09-20, accession 0001562180-22-006741
